add_grocery_item.name: add_grocery_item
add_grocery_item.description: Adds an item by label. A matching product's preferred store is assigned, else storeId or storeName. A product already on the list (not ticked) accumulates on its line, even in another unit. quantity with unit, or packagings (whole number >= 1, packaged products only), never both. A packaged product is counted in packagings, rounded up (asked quantity kept in desiredQuantity); with neither: restockQuantity, else the 7-day meal need, else 1. Returns productId, recipeNeed (base units, null when none), coversWeek, packagingsToCover.

answer_task_reminder.name: answer_task_reminder
answer_task_reminder.description: Answers a task reminder, as the notification button would. reminderId comes with the user's message. Actions: done (ticks the task), in10 (reminder in ten minutes), tonight (after dinner), tomorrow (into tomorrow's five), start (begins it now), open. A reminder is answered once and not every kind accepts every action: a refusal says why.

assign_product_store.name: assign_product_store
assign_product_store.description: Sets a product's preferredStoreId, fallbackStoreId, shelfLifeDays (null: non-perishable) and aisle: id or name (an unknown name creates it, see manage_aisles; empty string: none). The aisle applies to aisleStoreId, else the preferred store.

cancel_proaction.name: cancel_proaction
cancel_proaction.description: Cancels a proaction by its id (from list_proactions): it is removed from the « Maggie » agenda and will not run. Affects this occurrence only; a lasting habit is stopped by changing the instruction.

check_conflicts.name: check_conflicts
check_conflicts.description: Check for scheduling conflicts at a given date (YYYY-MM-DD), time (HH:MM) and duration in minutes (default 60).

check_grocery_item.name: check_grocery_item
check_grocery_item.description: Sets the checked state of an item: checked=true when bought, false to uncheck.

check_routine.name: check_routine
check_routine.description: Ticks a routine as done on a day, or removes the tick (done=false). id is from list_routines. date is YYYY-MM-DD, today in the user's timezone by default; a future day or one before the routine existed is refused. Repeating a tick or removing an absent one changes nothing. Returns {success, date, checked, routine}.

choose_workout_makeup.name: choose_workout_makeup
choose_workout_makeup.description: Plans the make-up chosen for a missed-session proposal. makeup_id: proposal id or IRI. option: softer (same session tonight, next quarter hour), shorter (shorter one tonight), tomorrow (same session tomorrow); softer and shorter only while offered (day of the miss, until 23:00). Creates a planned workout: {success, makeup, workout}. A proposal answers once: already chosen, obsolete or option too late → {error, status}.

claim_due_proactions.name: claim_due_proactions
claim_due_proactions.description: Atomically claims the pending proactions whose time has come (or the one given by id, due or not) and marks them running, each returned with its userId, prompt and kind; a check also carries signaledTopics, the topics delivered to its user these last 7 days ({topic, at, delivery, notice}). Executor only, never offered to the model.

create_event.name: create_event

reminders.description: minutes before the start, e.g. [60] for "une heure avant"

create_event.description: Create an event. Give a start and an end, never a duration: start_date (YYYY-MM-DD) + start_time (HH:MM) + end_date + end_time, or all_day true + start_date + end_date; end_date is EXCLUDED (1 January alone: 2037-01-01 to 2037-01-02). An incomplete schedule or an end not after the start creates nothing and returns an error. agenda_id: agenda name or id; omitted, inferred. Two equally plausible agendas, or a name matching none: error naming them, nothing created. reminders: minutes before start, e.g. [10, 1440]. rrule: RFC 5545 without the RRULE: prefix, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO; status: tentative or confirmed. Returns the saved event in its own time zone: allDay; startAt, endAt (timed); startDate, endDate, lastDay (whole-day); agenda; status; weekday, startWeekday, endWeekday, lastDayWeekday for each local date.

create_recipe.name: create_recipe
create_recipe.description: Create a recipe; with no ingredients and no steps it is refused, the error saying what is missing. ingredients: JSON array of {quantity, unit, ingredientId or ciqualAlimCode (creates the Ingredient from that Ciqual food), pieceWeightGrams?}; nutrition counts only ingredients with Ciqual values, and piece lines with pieceWeightGrams. steps: JSON array in order of {text, durationMinutes?, background? (timer runs while the cook moves on), ingredientIds? (recipe ids or names), utensils?, waitsFor? (earlier step positions)}. utensils: JSON array of ids or names; unknown names are added. tags: comma-separated.

create_task.name: create_task
create_task.description: Creates a task. priority: low, medium, high. criticality: low, medium, high, critical. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. parentId: a top-level task. estimatedMinutes 1-1440; firstStep. dueDate: deadline; scheduledDate: planned day. scheduledMoment: morning/afternoon/evening, or time with scheduledTime HH:MM; reminders (time only): minutes before, 0 at it. timed=true: timer. rrule (RFC 5545, no "RRULE:", DAILY-YEARLY, UNTIL not COUNT) repeats from scheduledDate, else dueDate, a day of the rule; done or past, the next task takes it.

delete_event.name: delete_event
delete_event.description: Delete a calendar event by its ID. Returns confirmation of deletion. A recurring series is designated by its master event's id; deleting it removes every occurrence.

delete_recipe.name: delete_recipe
delete_recipe.description: Delete a recipe by id. Meals with no other recipe are deleted with it (their shopping leaves the grocery list); other meals keep their recipes. Returns deletedMeals.

delete_task.name: delete_task
delete_task.description: Deletes a task by its id. Returns a confirmation.

detect_internal_transfers.name: detect_internal_transfers
detect_internal_transfers.description: Pairs movements between two of the user's own accounts so both legs leave every figure. Lines pair when on different accounts, with exactly opposite amounts, same currency, at most four days apart, already spent or committed. limitDays: integer >= 0, restricts to the last days (default: whole history). dryRun: true reports the pairs without writing. A savings or investment to checking transfer booked while the salary was late is marked advance; the checking to source transfer settling an open advance is marked repayment. A line with no other leg naming the holder or his bank is marked internal without counterpart (loneLegs). Hand-marked lines are never requalified.

end_errand.name: end_errand
end_errand.description: Archives checked items as past errands, one per store (errands: id, storeName, itemCount), removes them from the list, puts their products In Stock (restockedProducts), returns the unchecked items. storeId ends that store only; paidAmountCents (whole cents, needs storeId) records what was paid.

envelope_adjustments.name: envelope_adjustments
envelope_adjustments.description: Adjusts monthly envelopes to actual spending. month: YYYY-MM read (default current); amounts proposed are for the next month. Action suggest (writes nothing) lists each monthly envelope with amountCents, actualCents, targetAmountCents (next month's budget) and, only if it does not fit, suggestion {proposedCents, direction raise or lower, reason (French), seasonal}. Raise: exceeded three months running, spending mostly judged worth keeping. Lower: under three quarters three months running. Seasonal {fromMonth, toMonth}: same month of past years far from next month's amount, applied to that month every year. Avoidable spending never raises. Action apply writes next month's amounts for categoryIds (comma-separated; all when omitted), returns applied. Integer cents.

estimate_trip.name: estimate_trip
estimate_trip.description: Estimate the trip to an event, several modes at once. date (YYYY-MM-DD, Paris): the occurrence's day; required for a repeating event, else optional and must match. modes: drive, transit, walk, bicycle. origin: position (phone's last position, default), home (the user's home), place:<id> or event:<id>. leg: outbound (default) or return (event place to home, origin ignored, departAt required, ISO 8601 Paris time). arriveAt (ISO 8601 Paris time): required for a whole-day event, refused otherwise; departAt counts back from it. Returns {eventId, estimates: [{leg, mode, origin: {kind, id, label, latitude, longitude, capturedAt?}, steps: [{kind, minutes, label?}], durationMinutes, departAt, navigationUrl, parkingKnown, carLatitude?, carLongitude?}], unavailable: [{mode, reason}], locationRequested}. unavailable: modes with no route. locationRequested: position older than 10 min, used anyway. Refused: {error, field}; {error} alone if no route or Google unavailable.

generate_grocery_list.name: generate_grocery_list
generate_grocery_list.description: Top up the grocery list with recurring items due again (idempotent). Meals add nothing: mealsToChoose lists meals in the date range (YYYY-MM-DD) whose ingredients are not chosen (id, date, slot, summary), to choose with manage_meal_groceries.

get_activity_status.name: get_activity_status
get_activity_status.description: Reads the status of an activity left in progress. activity is cuisine, comptes or bilan (the evening review: step, answers, instructions). Returns {activity, origin, state, startedAt, updatedAt}, or null when nothing is in progress. Read-only.

get_daily_balance.name: get_daily_balance
get_daily_balance.description: Reads one day's calorie balance, date YYYY-MM-DD. Returns {date, eatenKcal, plannedKcal (planned meals not yet eaten), expendedKcal (get_daily_energy), balanceKcal = eaten + planned - expended, proteinG, carbsG, fatG, plannedMeals: [{mealId, slot, label, kcal, proteinG, carbsG, fatG}]}. expendedKcal, balanceKcal are null while the profile is incomplete.

get_daily_energy.name: get_daily_energy
get_daily_energy.description: Reads energy expenditure per day, from and to included (YYYY-MM-DD, max 400 days). Returns {days}: per local day {date, steps, activeKcal (Health Connect), bmrKcal, workoutKcal, stepsKcal (activeKcal minus sessions Health Connect counted), expendedKcal = bmrKcal + activeKcal + sessions Health Connect did not see}. Null without data; bmrKcal and expendedKcal null while the profile is incomplete.

get_day_context.name: get_day_context
get_day_context.description: Describes a day as {date, weekend, periods: [{id, name, agenda: {id, name}, allDay, start, end}]}. date is YYYY-MM-DD, today by default, read in Paris. periods are all those covering the day (custody, holidays, sickness…); start and end are the occurrence bounds, instants or days with the end day included.

get_day_plan.name: get_day_plan
get_day_plan.description: Reads the day: at most 5 slots. date YYYY-MM-DD, today by default. Returns slots [{position, type, task}], now (first slot not done, or null), reserve (other open non-subtasks by orderScore), done, total, confirmedAt (null while proposed). A task has id, title, estimatedMinutes, firstStep, completedAt, dueDate, postponedSince, urgency, criticality.

get_event.name: get_event
get_event.description: Get one calendar event by its ID: summary, start, end, all-day flag and agenda. Works for past events too. A whole-day event (allDay true) has no startAt/endAt but startDate, endDate (EXCLUDED, as in Google's API: the day after its last day) and lastDay. Every local date comes with its day of the week (startWeekday, endWeekday for a timed event; startWeekday and lastDayWeekday for a whole-day one).

get_events.name: get_events

agendas.description: names or ids of the agendas to read

get_events.description: Gets events from all agendas, recurring events expanded: one day, a range, or a search by name. from: first day (YYYY-MM-DD), default now. to: last day, included; default from + 6 days (from + 365 days with query). At most 31 days without query, 366 with. query: word(s) of a title or place; a recurring series comes back once, as master (id, rrule, first occurrence of the window in startAt). agendas: names (case and accents ignored) or ids; a name matching no agenda returns an error listing the agendas. Omit to read all. A whole-day event (allDay true) has startDate, endDate (EXCLUDED: the day after its last day) and lastDay, no startAt/endAt. Local dates come with their weekday (startWeekday, endWeekday; whole-day: startWeekday, lastDayWeekday). Each event has agenda (name) and timeZone. Returns {from, to, events, count}.

get_exercises.name: get_exercises
get_exercises.description: Reads the exercise catalogue. Optional: pattern (vertical_pull, horizontal_pull, vertical_push, horizontal_push, squat, hinge, lunge, core_anterior, core_lateral), equipment (list of pull_up_bar, weighted_bag, chair, table, band, parallel_bars, wall; empty = bodyweight only), slug. Returns {exercises}: {slug, name, pattern, primaryMuscles, secondaryMuscles, kind, equipment, nervousCost, eccentric, unit (reps, seconds, meters), perSide, loadable, ladders}. Unknown value: {error}.

get_fasting.name: get_fasting
get_fasting.description: Reads one day's intermittent fast, date YYYY-MM-DD, derived from the food journal. Returns {date, protocol (14:10, 16:8, 18:6, 20:4; null if none), windowStart, windowEnd (HH:MM), openedAt (first intake), lastIntakeAt, state (fasting: nothing eaten yet; open: until windowEnd; closed), nightFastMinutes (previous day's last intake to this day's first)}. A future day gives its window only.

get_finance_projection.name: get_finance_projection
get_finance_projection.description: Projects what comes, from entered data only (nothing is extrapolated). months: 1 to 12 (default: to the end of the month after the expected salary). Integer cents. salary {isConfigured, expectedOn, referenceCents, isLate, delayDays, shortfallCents}, balanceCents (checking today), projection[] day by day, overdraft {isForecast, onDate, worstBalanceCents, limitCents}, outstandingAdvancesCents; nextWeek and nextMonth: the week and month after this one with incomeCents, expenseCents, netCents and their lines. Moves no money.

get_finance_summary.name: get_finance_summary
get_finance_summary.description: Reads the financial state of a period (period: YYYY-MM, default current month, or YYYY). spending: every debit against what was planned, with the daily curve. envelopes: consumed vs budgeted. satisfaction: worth keeping vs avoidable. savings: put aside vs planned capacity. cushion. toQualify: unqualified lines. scores: week, month and global colours with their reasons (null for a year). salary: reference monthly salary, its source (declared, expected, measured, unknown) and the delay. advances: money taken from savings, outstanding per source. independence: how far the rentes cover the lifestyle. Integer cents.

get_grocery_list.name: get_grocery_list
get_grocery_list.description: The list by store in visit order, then aisle (aisle {id, name, position}, null last), then position. Items with buyAfter in the future are in later; includeDeferred=true moves them into the store groups. One line per product: needed (base units), quantity and unit to buy (whole packagings for a packaged product), desiredQuantity, desiredUnit, packaging (null when none), stockState.

get_health_day.name: get_health_day
get_health_day.description: Reads one local day of the health journal, date YYYY-MM-DD. Returns {day: {id, date, weightKg, bodyFatPercent, weighedAt (first weighing of the day not set aside), steps, eatenKcal, expendedKcal, balanceKcal (eaten - expended; today live, planned meals included), sportMinutes, mood, fatigue (1-10), note, notedBy (user, maggie), notedAt}}. Null when nothing is recorded.

get_health_profile.name: get_health_profile
get_health_profile.description: Reads the health profile. Returns {id (null if never written), sex, birthYear, age, heightCm, weightKg (latest weighing not set aside), activityLevel (sedentary x1.2 to very_active x1.9), mode (computed, entered), bmrKcal, needKcal, factor (need / bmr), stepGoal, suggestionWindowStart, suggestionWindowEnd, sessionMinutes, stepSource}. bmrKcal, needKcal null while sex, age, height or weight is missing.

get_my_location.name: get_my_location
get_my_location.description: Reads the user's phone last GPS position. Returns {position}: {latitude, longitude, accuracy (metres), capturedAt, ageMinutes}, or null when the phone never reported a GPS point (the position must be allowed in the app). Only GPS positions are stored, and the last one stays the position whatever its age.

get_next_prescription.name: get_next_prescription
get_next_prescription.description: Returns the next prescription for one exercise from the coded progression rules. exercise: catalogue slug; variant: normal (default), soft (one set less, 3 reps in reserve), deload (half the sets, 3 reps in reserve). Returns {prescription, reason, basedOn}: prescription = an exercise line for manage_workouts (its exercise may differ from the one asked); reason = the rule applied; basedOn = ids of the sessions read. Unknown slug or variant: {error}.

get_project_planning.name: get_project_planning
get_project_planning.description: Computes the next 36 months of project purchases from the net saving capacity. No arguments. Months are YYYY-MM, amounts integer cents. The safety cushion is filled first, then projects take the rest in priority order; none is bought before its dependencies. Returns startMonth; netCapacityCents; isIncomeKnown (false: capacity is 0); cushion {state building|recharging|complete, completeMonth}; projects[] {projectId, name, position, amountCents, dateMode, targetOn, savingFromMonth, purchaseMonth (null beyond horizon), gatheredCents, isDeadlineMissed, delayMonths, unmetDependencies}; months[] {month, capacityCents, cushionCents, salaryCents, savingsCents, loanPaymentsCents, isOverCapacity}.

get_purchase_suggestions.name: get_purchase_suggestions
get_purchase_suggestions.description: Products bought 3+ times in past errands and due again: everyDays (median gap), lastBoughtOn, dueOn (YYYY-MM-DD), usualQuantity, usualUnit (null when unknown). Products already listed, recurring or dismissed are left out.

get_recipe.name: get_recipe
get_recipe.description: Get a recipe by id with ingredients, utensils and steps (text, durationMinutes, background, ingredients, utensils, waitsFor = positions awaited). guests (1 or more) scales quantities (x guests / servings) without changing the recipe; the answer carries scaledFor and scaleFactor.

get_recurring_operations.name: get_recurring_operations
get_recurring_operations.description: Reads recurring operations (subscriptions, rent, salary), no arguments. totals: monthlyCostCents, yearlyCostCents (expenses, negative), monthlyIncomeCents, activeCount; signed integer cents; an ended series (endsOn past) is listed but not totalled. operations[]: id, label, category, account, period, dayRule, referenceAmountCents, monthlyCostCents, yearlyCostCents, currency, nextOccurrenceOn (null once ended), lastAttachedOn, attachmentCount, lastOccurrence (dateGapDays, deviations late, early, amount_up, amount_down), missedOccurrence (occurrenceOn, daysOverdue; set when the latest due date is past tolerance with no transaction), priceChange (previousCents, currentCents, percent, since). proposals[]: attachments awaiting confirmation with reason (late, early, amount_up, amount_down, ambiguous); confirmed with manage_operations attach.

get_seasonal_produce.name: get_seasonal_produce
get_seasonal_produce.description: Fruits and vegetables in season in metropolitan France for month (1-12, default: current), and the user's own products in season (season set by manage_products seasonMonths).

get_tasks.name: get_tasks
get_tasks.description: Gets tasks, filters combined with AND. status: pending (default), done, all. day (YYYY-MM-DD): planned that day, or due that day or before and not done. dueFrom/dueTo, scheduledFrom/scheduledTo: inclusive bounds. dated: false = no due nor planned day, true = one of them. parentId: the subtasks of a task. limit: 50, at most 200. Highest orderScore first; done: most recently done first. Returns {tasks, count, total}; a task has urgency (low, normal, high, critical), orderScore and overdueDays (null if not late).

get_training_status.name: get_training_status
get_training_status.description: Reads the strength program status, date YYYY-MM-DD. Returns {date, programWeek (from the first done calibration session), phase (calibration weeks 1-2, ramp_up 3-4, normal), deload {due, reason (scheduled, stagnation, hard_sessions, null), weeksSinceLast}, stagnating (slugs without gain for over 14 days), week {planned, done}, hardSetsByPattern}. Invalid date: {error}.

get_user_timezone.name: get_user_timezone
get_user_timezone.description: Reads the IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Paris) the user chose in their preferences, and their working hours (HH:MM start and end, ISO days 1 = Monday … 7).

get_weather.name: get_weather
get_weather.description: Daily forecast from Open-Meteo: condition (text, `condition_code`: clear, partly_cloudy, cloudy, fog, drizzle, rain, showers, snow, storm), min/max temperature (°C), rain (mm, probability), wind and gusts (km/h), alerts. Without `date`: today and tomorrow; with `date` (YYYY-MM-DD, up to 15 days ahead): that day. `location`: city, default the user's. Failure returns `error`.

import_bank_transactions.name: import_bank_transactions
import_bank_transactions.description: Imports chosen bank movements into Maggie. accountId, from, to: as given to read_bank_statement (the bank is read again); refs[]: ref values of chosen entries, 200 at most. Movements already in Maggie are skipped, so a rerun imports nothing. Returns {imported, skipped, unknownRefs (absent from the bank's answer), transactionIds}; or status history_unavailable / rate_limited with the bank's message, nothing imported. Error: refs empty or above 200. Imported movements have no category, like the regular sync (qualify with manage_transactions, manage_peer_debts for a transfer with a person).

list_daily_rendezvous.name: list_daily_rendezvous
list_daily_rendezvous.description: Lists each user's daily rendezvous settings (morning digest, evening review: on or off, HH:MM hour). Executor only, never offered to the model.

list_past_errands.name: list_past_errands
list_past_errands.description: Past errands, most recent first: one store each (storeName, null when none), endedAt (ISO 8601), items (label, quantity, unit, product IRI or null, packaging fields). store matches the name in part, case-insensitively; limit 1-20 (default 5).

list_places.name: list_places
list_places.description: Reads the user's places, home (« Maison ») first then by name, as {places: [...]}. A place has id, name, address, latitude and longitude (null until the address is located), parkingAddress, parkingLatitude and parkingLongitude (null when none), and isHome. When there is no home, the address of the owner's Google account is imported as « Maison » if it has one.

list_proactions.name: list_proactions
list_proactions.description: Lists the proactions scheduled for the user, by time, each with its prompt, scheduledAt and status (pending, running, completed with its response, failed with its error). from and to (ISO 8601, or YYYY-MM-DD for a whole day, read in Europe/Paris) bound scheduledAt; status filters.

list_routines.name: list_routines
list_routines.description: Reads routines. Without date: all, as {routines}. With date (YYYY-MM-DD): active routines due that day, as {date, moments: [{anchor, time, routines}]}. A routine has id, title, anchor (wake, afterBreakfast, afterLunch, afterDinner, time), anchorTime HH:MM, time, recurrence ({kind, weekday, monthDay}), active, remind, createdAt, checkedToday, dueToday, monthCount, totalCount.

list_trips.name: list_trips
list_trips.description: Read the trips kept with set_trip that leave on a day (date, YYYY-MM-DD, read in Paris), by departure time, as {date, trips: [...]}, each as set_trip returns it, with originDecidedBy (user or maggie).

manage_accounts.name: manage_accounts
manage_accounts.description: List, create, update, delete or link bank accounts: name, bank, type (checking, savings, investment, cash), currency (ISO 4217), balance in integer cents, optional cushion flag (emergency fund). On update only provided fields change; list bank in clear to empty it. link folds the bank-created account (bankAccountId, absorbed) into the hand-typed one (accountId, kept): the kept account keeps its name, type, cushion flag and references and takes the bank connection, identification and balance; the absorbed one's movements move onto it (twins dropped after their category is carried over), then it is deleted. Without confirm nothing is written: it returns the preview (kept, moved, dropped); confirm true applies it. Refused when the kept account is already bank-linked, the other is not, the currencies differ, or an account is not the user's.

manage_agendas.name: manage_agendas
manage_agendas.description: Lists, creates, updates or deletes agendas. An agenda has a name, description, IANA time zone, colour and a default flag. On update, an optional field is emptied by listing its name in clear (description, color). A Google-connected agenda is renamed in Google too: if Google refuses the name, the update fails with an error and the agenda keeps its name.

manage_aisles.name: manage_aisles
manage_aisles.description: Actions: list, create, update (rename and/or move), reorder, delete the aisles of a store (position 1 first). list, create, reorder need storeId; update, delete need aisleId. create is last unless position is given. reorder takes aisleIds (all of the store). Deleting leaves its products without an aisle there.

manage_body_measurements.name: manage_body_measurements
manage_body_measurements.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete, exclude. Fields: measuredAt (ISO 8601 with offset, default now), weightKg (max 500), bodyFatPercent (<100), waistCm (max 300), all >0, at least one on create; source (manual default, health_connect, withings), externalId, excluded (kept, not counted). update, delete, exclude need measurementId; update changes only fields given. list: after, before, limit (max 366). Returns {measurements} or {success, measurement}. Refusal changes nothing: {error, field?, current?}.

manage_categories.name: manage_categories
manage_categories.description: List, create, update or delete budget categories. A tree of at most three levels (parentId; a level-3 category has no children, none moves under its own descendants or past level 3). Read with depth (1-3) and path (names joined by « › »). obligation (deprecated, only the default qualification of a new transaction line): mandatory, optional, saving, investment, debt or income. passiveIncome flags an income category whose money comes in without work (rent, dividends, interest, royalties): the independence counter counts it; refused on any other category. On update only provided fields change; list parentId, color or icon in clear to empty them.

manage_contacts.name: manage_contacts
manage_contacts.description: People the owner lends money to or borrows from (one list), and the counterparties: labels under which each appears on bank statements (e.g. « VIR. DE TOM MARTIN »). Actions: list (contacts with counterparties); search (query, by name); create (name, optional notes); update (contactId; only provided fields change; clear lists notes to empty); delete (contactId; transactions detached); link_counterparty (contactId and label or transactionId, whose label is used; attaches every non-internal transaction it recognises, past and future; a label belongs to one contact); unlink_counterparty (counterpartyId; transactions detached); suggest_counterparties (contactId; labels of unattached transactions containing a word of the name, most frequent first). A transfer between the owner's own accounts is never attached to a contact.

manage_cooking_timers.name: manage_cooking_timers
manage_cooking_timers.description: Actions: list, start, pause, resume, add, cancel. list returns running, paused and done timers (label, step, remainingSeconds, endsAt). start needs label, recipeId, stepPosition, durationSeconds; pause, resume, cancel need timerId; add needs timerId and seconds (negative removes). A refusal returns error plus the current timers.

manage_envelopes.name: manage_envelopes
manage_envelopes.description: Budget envelopes: one category for one period, amountCents a positive integer in cents. mode monthly needs year + month (1-12), annual needs year, one_off is an event: name + amountCents, no category or period (spends join it via manage_transactions oneOffEnvelopeId). Actions: list; set (categoryId, amountCents; creates or updates that category's envelope); update (envelopeId + fields); delete; status (year, month, default current: per envelope spent, committed, planned, consumed, remaining, available; outsideMonthlyBudget lists annual and oneOff ones); rollover (fromYear/fromMonth to year/month; same amounts, or actual spending if useActualSpending; existing targets untouched); split (envelopeId of the mother, children [{envelopeId, amountCents}] among its direct sub-category envelopes; over-allocation is refused). seasonalAmounts (monthly, set/update): [{fromMonth, toMonth, amountCents}], months 1-12; amountCents covers the other months; replaces all seasons, [] removes them.

manage_food_intakes.name: manage_food_intakes
manage_food_intakes.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete. list needs date (YYYY-MM-DD): {intakes, plannedMeals (not yet eaten)}. create, one of: mealId alone (eats the planned meal, eatenAt defaults to now); else eatenAt (ISO 8601 with offset, required) + label + kcal (0-10000), optional proteinG, carbsG, fatG (grams), quantityGrams; ciqualCode (search_ciqual_foods) + eatenAt + quantityGrams, kcal and macros from Ciqual unless given. update, delete need foodIntakeId; update changes only fields given, nothing recomputed; deleting a meal's intake makes the meal planned again. Returns {success, intake}. Refusal: {error, field?, current?}, nothing changes.

manage_ingredients.name: manage_ingredients
manage_ingredients.description: Actions: create (needs name, category), update and delete (need ingredientId). category: produce, dairy, meat, fish, grain, spice, condiment, frozen, beverage, other. Units: g, kg, ml, l, cl, piece, bunch, can, bottle, pack, sachet, jar. ciqualAlimCode (search_ciqual_foods) supplies macros and micronutrients. pieceWeightGrams: grams of one piece, for recipe nutrition. packagingUnit, with packagingSize and packagingSizeUnit for its content, always together (pack, 500, g). stockState: in_stock (default), low, out. restockQuantity: packagings to buy when out (integer, 0 or more). autoRestock: relists itself. clear (update): optional fields to empty (not name, category, stockState, autoRestock).

manage_investments.name: manage_investments
manage_investments.description: Makes a project an investment. Actions: get, set, remove; all need projectId. get returns the investment (null if none). set takes the WHOLE investment, replacing the current one, in integer cents: downPaymentCents (required, 0 allowed; loan = price minus it), monthlyRentCents (required, 0 allowed), priceCents (optional), loan (required unless the down payment is the whole price or the project already has a loan source): {annualRateBasisPoints, durationMonths}; resale (optional, null = none): {month YYYY-MM, netAmountCents, targetProjectId?}. remove keeps the project and its funding. A missing value is refused with the list of what is missing, plus current.

manage_loans.name: manage_loans
manage_loans.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete, timeline, early_repayment. Integer cents, rates basis points, ISO dates. create needs name, principalRemainingCents, monthlyPaymentCents. clear lists fields to empty. type: amortizing_fixed (default); amortizing_variable (needs referenceIndex, marginBasisPoints; optional rateCapBasisPoints, rateFloorBasisPoints); in_fine, bridge (need durationMonths); stepped (needs steps [{fromMonth from 1, monthlyPaymentCents}]); deferred_partial, deferred_total (need deferralMonths > 0). Optional: periodicity (monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual), prepaymentPenaltyMode (legal_cap default, fixed needs prepaymentPenaltyFixedCents, exempt), partialRepaymentEffect (shorten, lower_payment). projected = true: unsigned loan. timeline: horizonMonths. early_repayment: loanId, optional amountCents; returns penaltyCents, realGainCents. An invalid or missing condition is refused with error plus current.

manage_meal_groceries.name: manage_meal_groceries
manage_meal_groceries.description: Choose the ingredients of a planned meal that go on the grocery list. preview lists them with toBuy (packagings), stock state (in_stock, low, out), suggested=true when low or out. add puts only ingredientIds (comma-separated, from preview; empty adds nothing) on the list, replacing what the meal put there.

manage_meal_settings.name: manage_meal_settings
manage_meal_settings.description: Actions: get, update. defaultGuests: people per meal without guests of its own (1 or more, 2 by default). update needs it and rescales the grocery list for upcoming meals following the default.

manage_meals.name: manage_meals
manage_meals.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete. A meal is a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a slot (lunch, dinner); recipeIds comma-separated. list needs fromDate and toDate, or query (title words, tolerant to case, accents, typos; all agendas, next year when no dates). create needs date and slot, returns groceryPreview (ingredients with stock), to choose from with manage_meal_groceries. guests (1 or more) scales recipes and, on update, the grocery list; unset follows the manage_meal_settings default, useDefaultGuests true restores it. update and delete need mealId.

manage_notifications.name: manage_notifications
manage_notifications.description: Actions: create, list, delete, and mark as read (unknown ones refused, valid listed). create sends a push: type (proaction, approval, reminder, task_due, grocery, finance, message, question), title, optional body, relatedEntityIri, the screen a tap opens (/api/events/{id}, /api/tasks/{id}, /finance/banks, message: /chat?message={id}). question needs interaction {kind: choice, options, multiple, questionId}. list: unreadOnly, limit. Mark as read and delete need notificationId.

manage_operations.name: manage_operations
manage_operations.description: Manage operations: criteria plus a qualification copied onto matching transactions; with a recurrence it is a series, otherwise a categorization rule. Criteria: counterpartyName, labelPattern + matchType contains|starts_with|equals, direction debit|credit, minAmountCents/maxAmountCents (absolute cents); none is refused with current state. Recurrence (fixed at creation; all four or none, else refused with current values): period, anchorOn ISO, referenceAmountCents (signed, not 0), accountId; plus label. list: recurring filter; series return monthlyCostCents, yearlyCostCents, nextOccurrenceOn. update: provided fields only; clear removes label, counterpartyName, labelPattern, minAmountCents, maxAmountCents, endsOn. preview: same criteria (operationId when editing), returns total, changeCount. create/update: applyToExisting (default false). apply: operationId, or all. learn: transactionId, categoryId. attach: operationId, transactionId; refused if occurrence taken or account, currency, sign differ. detach: transactionId. delete: operationId. mandatory (bool, cannot be cut) and kind (none, saving, investment, loan, repayment: debit = I pay back, credit = I am paid back) qualify with the category: all together or none, a partial set is refused with the current qualification. Alone, a new categoryId brings the category's qualification.

manage_peer_debts.name: manage_peer_debts

shares.description: what the agent sent: checked one by one

manage_peer_debts.description: Créances (people owe the owner) and dettes (the owner owes them); bank loans: manage_loans. Integer cents. list: optional contactId, status, direction. summary: owedToMeCents, iOweCents per contact. set_my_share: transactionId of a spend, myShareCents (owner's part, 0 <= part < amount), shares [{contactId, amountCents}] for the others (omit amountCents to split equally, else sum = amount - part), optional object, notes; null myShareCents removes it. record_debt: transactionId of a received transfer, contactId (sender), amountCents to give back (0 < amount <= transfer), optional object, notes; null amountCents removes it; both refused once repaid. allocate: transactionId, kind; received: income, repayment, new_debt (contactId, amountCents); sent: repayment, new_claim (contactId), other. repayment needs shareId (from list) and amountCents <= its remainder, 0 detaches; one allocation per call; kind null undoes; internal transfers refused. Returns peerKind, allocations, unallocatedCents.

manage_period_plan.name: manage_period_plan
manage_period_plan.description: Writes one element of a period plan per call. period: year (2027), quarter (2027-Q2) or semester (2027-S1), as in plan_annual_budget. Actions: set_annual_envelope (categoryId, amountCents; period a year); set_monthly_envelope (categoryId, amountCents) same envelope on every month, seasonFromMonth + seasonToMonth + seasonAmountCents together (1-12) give those months another amount, one season per call, replacing the seasons; set_one_off_envelope (name, amountCents) for an event with no category; set_event (categoryId, label, amountCents, month YYYY-MM in the period, optional accountId) plans an expense on the 15th, on the first checking account unless accountId. amountCents positive; currency default EUR. Replaying updates, never duplicates; committed expenses are left alone. Calendar untouched.

manage_periods.name: manage_periods
manage_periods.description: Manage periods: stretches of life (custody, holidays, a trip), not events, never synced with Google. Fields: name, agenda_id (id or name), schedule given whole: start_date (YYYY-MM-DD) + start_time (HH:MM) + end_date + end_time, or all_day true + start_date + end_date (EXCLUDED), rrule: RFC 5545 without the RRULE: prefix, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2. list: from, to (YYYY-MM-DD, to included) returns periods meeting those days, repeats unfolded; else every period as stored. create: name, agenda_id, schedule. update: period_id, only given fields (rrule "" stops repeating). delete: period_id, removes the series. Refused: error plus current. Returns what was saved in the period's zone, with startWeekday, endWeekday or lastDayWeekday, and lastDay for days.

manage_placements.name: manage_placements
manage_placements.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete, simulate. Fields: name; initial (integer cents >= 0, paid on day one); deposit (integer cents >= 0); frequency (monthly, quarterly, yearly: deposit at each period end; once: on day one); annualRate (basis points, 0 to 10000, 600 = 6 %); years (1 to 60). create needs all six, and initial and deposit are not both 0. A placement is read back with final, paid, interest, rent and monthlyDeposit, all integer cents. simulate with placementId returns the saved placement year by year; without it, a what-if from initial, deposit, frequency, annualRate and years. A refusal returns error plus current.

manage_products.name: manage_products
manage_products.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete non-food products (food: manage_ingredients). Units: g, kg, ml, l, cl, piece, bunch, can, bottle, pack, sachet, jar. packagingUnit, with packagingSize and packagingSizeUnit together. stockState: in_stock (default), low, out. restockQuantity: packagings, whole number >= 0; seasonMonths: months 1-12 in season in France, pre-filled on create when the name is known; inSeason returned. clear lists fields to empty: defaultUnit, packagingUnit, packagingSize, packagingSizeUnit, restockQuantity, seasonMonths.

manage_project_funding.name: manage_project_funding

sources.description: a list of {kind, amountCents, account?, placement?, loan?}

manage_project_funding.description: Actions: set, options; both need projectId. set takes sources, the WHOLE list replacing the current one ([] removes all): {kind, amountCents (integer cents > 0), account?, placement?, loan?}. kind savings: account = id of a savings or checking account outside the safety cushion. kind capital: account = id of an investment account; placement = optional simulated placement id. kind loan: creates a projected loan; loan = {annualRateBasisPoints, durationMonths} required, optional manage_loans conditions; omitted loan keeps current conditions. At most one loan source; sources cannot exceed the project's amount. options prices cash, loan and partial, each with totalCostCents, netCostCents, monthlyPaymentCents, durationMonths, availableInMonths. Inputs: yieldBasisPoints (required, 0 allowed), loanRateBasisPoints and loanMonths, downPaymentCents (required without a loan source). A missing value is refused with the list of what is missing, plus current.

manage_projects.name: manage_projects
manage_projects.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete, reorder. create needs name and amountCents (integer cents > 0). currency: 3-letter code, default EUR. Dates ISO. wellbeing: essential = 4, high = 3, medium = 2 (default), comfort = 1. dateMode: none, movable, fixed, deadline; fixed and deadline require targetOn, and targetOn requires one of them. dependsOn: ids of the projects this one waits for, replaces the whole list; no self-dependency or cycle.position: 0 = first priority, a new project goes last; reorder takes ids = EVERY project id in the new order (a partial list is refused). update changes only provided fields; clear empties note, dependsOn or targetOn. A refusal returns error plus current.

manage_recurring_groceries.name: manage_recurring_groceries
manage_recurring_groceries.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete recurring items, added to generated lists. frequency: weekly, biweekly, monthly. Needs a productId or a customLabel. clear lists fields to empty: productId, customLabel, quantity, unit; one of the two must remain.

manage_safety_cushion.name: manage_safety_cushion
manage_safety_cushion.description: Reads or configures the safety cushion (emergency fund filled before projects and investments). Action status: state (building, complete, recharging), target (targetMonths x monthly net income), holding (balance of cushion-flagged accounts less peerClaimsCents, what others owe the owner), deficit, monthly recharge plan; the amount is never set by hand. Planning: below criticalMonths of spending (criticalCents) all saving capacity goes to the cushion; above, cushionSharePercent % (capped at the deficit), the rest to projects and investments; once full, all to them. Action configure sets any of targetMonths, monthlyNetIncomeCents, criticalMonths (0-24, default 2), cushionSharePercent (0-100, default 60), rechargeCapCents, rechargeTargetMonths (indicative); only given fields change, at least one required. Amounts are integer cents.

manage_scenarios.name: manage_scenarios
manage_scenarios.description: Project scenarios: name, ordered projectIds (first = first priority), early repayments, placementIds, monthlySaving (integer cents a month replacing the measured capacity). repayments: [{loanId, month YYYY-MM, amountCents or null = whole capital, effect duration|payment}]. Actions: list; get (scenarioId; adds curve, events); create (name, projectIds); duplicate (scenarioId, optional name); update (scenarioId + fields; resetMonthlySaving=true restores the measured capacity); delete; make_current (scenarioId; the single current scenario drives the Dashboard and treasury); clear_current; compare (scenarioIds, 2+, first = reference); timeline (optional scenarioId); suggest (like create, draft of kind advisor, never current). Returns id, name, kind (user, auto, advisor), status (draft, saved), current, projects, monthlySaving, nDate (YYYY-MM). auto-* scenarios are read-only: duplicate, then edit. A refusal returns error plus current.

manage_stores.name: manage_stores
manage_stores.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete stores, with visitOrder and a description of what they sell (used to assign products). clear lists fields to empty: description.

manage_transactions.name: manage_transactions
manage_transactions.description: Manage transactions. Amounts: signed integer cents (negative = expense); dates ISO. list: filters accountId, categoryId (with sub-categories), direction, fromDate/toDate inclusive, query, transferKind; newest first, limit 30 (max 100), returns total; rejected payments only with transferKind rejected. create: accountId, label, amountCents; bookedAt defaults today; status spent|committed|planned|to_arbitrate. update: transactionId, provided fields only; clear removes categoryId, transferKind, recurringOperation, note, oneOffEnvelope, advanceSource; retrospect keep|avoidable|unrated (refused on income or transfer); note max 2000. categorize: transactionId, categoryId. to_sort: uncategorised lines, limit 50, returns total, totalCents, suggestion. sort: transactionId + categoryId or transferKind internal; refused if already sorted. settle_rejection/unsettle_rejection: transactionId of a rejected payment leg, else refused. delete: transactionId. mandatory (bool, cannot be cut) and kind (none, saving, investment, loan, repayment: debit = I pay back, credit = I am paid back) qualify with the category: all together or none, a partial set is refused with the current qualification. Alone, a new categoryId brings the category's qualification.

manage_treasury_settings.name: manage_treasury_settings
manage_treasury_settings.description: Actions: get, update. Settings: salaryExpectedDay (1 to 31, last day on shorter months) and overdraftLimitCents (positive integer cents, default 0). get returns the settings and salaryDelay. update changes only the given fields; clearSalaryExpectedDay true forgets the day. salaryDelay covers the previous and current month: isConfigured (false without expected day or reference salary, then nothing is late), isLate, delayDays, shortfallCents, months[] {month, expectedOn, receivedCents, isReceived}. The salary is late from the day after the expected day until credits recognised as salary reach 90 % of the reference salary.

manage_utensils.name: manage_utensils
manage_utensils.description: Actions: list, create, rename, delete kitchen utensils (oven, Thermomix...). create and rename need name (255 characters at most); rename and delete need utensilId. Names are unique whatever the case: create returns the existing one. Delete removes it from its recipes.

manage_workouts.name: manage_workouts

exercises.description: the list as the agent sent it, checked by the handler

manage_workouts.description: Actions: list, create, update, delete. Fields: type (run, walk, bike, swim, strength, climbing, other), title, startedAt (ISO 8601 with offset), durationMinutes, distanceMeters (metres), kcal, avgHeartRate, feeling (very_good, good, hard, very_hard), source (manual default, watch, activity, estimated, planned = still to do), externalId, difficulty (1-10), variant (normal, calibration, soft, deload), exercises: ordered list, always sent WHOLE, replaces the previous one. Exercise: exercise (slug), step, sets, target (per set), targetMin, targetMax, restSeconds, tempo (true = 3 s down, 1 s pause), loadKg, targetRir, cue, feeling (too_easy, right, too_hard), done (list of {reps}, {seconds} or {meters}, plus loadKg); both done only. create needs type, title, startedAt, durationMinutes. update, delete need workoutId; update changes given fields only. list filters type, source, exercise (slug), after, before (on startedAt), limit (max 100). Returns {workouts} or {success, workout}. Refusal (nothing changes): {error, field?, current?}. A planned strength session is refused (current = the week's strength sessions) if the week has 3, it is under 24 h from another, or it is the 3rd with an eccentric exercise or under 48 h from another.

mark_grocery_item_missing.name: mark_grocery_item_missing
mark_grocery_item_missing.description: Marks an unchecked item missing: it moves to the product's fallback store if any, else stays. missing=false moves it back to the store it was missing from.

monthly_review.name: monthly_review
monthly_review.description: Monthly look back (year, month; default the month just ended). Action review lists non-mandatory spends without a verdict, biggest first, with the amount kept, the amount judged avoidable, an optimisation score (share of judged amount worth keeping, null if none judged) and the comparison with the previous month, the average of the last three months and the same month last year. Action rate (transactionId, verdict: keep, avoidable, or unrated to undo) records one verdict. Only non-mandatory spends are offered.

move_to_fallback.name: move_to_fallback
move_to_fallback.description: Moves every unchecked item of a closed store to its product's fallback store.

plan_annual_budget.name: plan_annual_budget
plan_annual_budget.description: Reads the yearly planning session: what the year behind cost, with a suggested budget for the year ahead. year: 2000 to 2100 (default: next year in November and December, else the current one). thresholdCents: integer cents, default 10000, selects debits listed individually. period (2027, 2027-Q2 or 2027-S1): plans a quarter or semester instead (reads the period just before); not with year (error). Lists every category that cost something, biggest first: budgeted and consumed, big expenses, plannedCents, committedCents, decidedCents, the annual envelope set, and the suggested amount (suggestedMonthlyCents for a period). Writes go through manage_period_plan.

preview_project.name: preview_project
preview_project.description: Computes the planning twice, without and with a new project, and changes nothing. scenarioId: a stored scenario id, or auto-rapid, auto-balanced, auto-quality. Same fields as manage_projects create: name and amountCents (integer cents, > 0) required; currency (default EUR); wellbeing essential|high|medium (default)|comfort; dateMode none (default)|fixed|deadline with targetOn (YYYY-MM-DD); dependsOn (project ids). Returns scenario {id, name, editable} or null; dates[] {projectId, name, before, after} (purchase month YYYY-MM, null beyond 36 months); nDate {before, after} (independence month, null beyond 20 years). A refusal returns error plus current.

read_bank_statement.name: read_bank_statement
read_bank_statement.description: Reads one bank account's movements over a period straight from the bank; nothing is written. accountId: a bank-linked Maggie account; from, to: YYYY-MM-DD (to default today). Filters: search (label or counterparty, ignoring case and accents), direction (credit or debit), minAmountCents (absolute value). Returns status ok, entries[] ({ref, bookedOn, amountCents signed, label, counterparty, inMaggie}), firstDay, lastDay, count, truncated (true when entries[] holds the first 200 or the bank has more pages). ref feeds import_bank_transactions. Refusals: status history_unavailable (period over about 90 days needs a new strong authentication) with the bank's message; status rate_limited (daily ceiling).

read_web_page.name: read_web_page
read_web_page.description: Reads a public web page: returns its `title`, its main readable `text` (bounded) and `structured`, the schema.org JSON-LD objects as published (`Recipe`, `Event`, `Product`, `Article`, `LocalBusiness`…). Only public http(s) pages are read, without JavaScript and without the user\'s login; a page that is private, too big, too slow or refused returns an `error` with the reason. Read-only.

record_proaction_result.name: record_proaction_result
record_proaction_result.description: Records the outcome of a claimed (running) proaction: completed with response (may be empty), or failed with error. A completed run also keeps delivery (interrupt, thread or none), topic_key, the verdict (impact low|medium|high, evidence weak|solid, deadline ISO 8601, changed), notice (the sentence of the interruption) and message_link (/chat?message=<id>). Executor only, never offered to the model.

remove_grocery_item.name: remove_grocery_item
remove_grocery_item.description: Removes an item from the list.

reorder_grocery_items.name: reorder_grocery_items
reorder_grocery_items.description: Sets item positions from items, a list of {id, position}.

replace_recipe_ingredient.name: replace_recipe_ingredient
replace_recipe_ingredient.description: Replace the product of a recipe line; steps using the old ingredient use the new one. ingredientId: current line ingredient; new one is withIngredientId or withCiqualAlimCode; quantity, unit kept when omitted. Step texts change only with rewriteText true; the answer lists textSuggestions ({position, before, after}).

save_bilan_step.name: save_bilan_step
save_bilan_step.description: Records the evening review state. day: YYYY-MM-DD. step: journee, finance, sante, consignes, demain. answers (optional): {tasks: [{taskId, choice: done|tomorrow|later}], mood, fatigue, note}; instructions (optional): [{id, text, kind: reminder|task|instruction, targetId?}]; omitted keeps stored values of that day. Returns the status, or {error}.

save_place.name: save_place
save_place.description: Creates a place (without id) or changes one (with id, from list_places). name and address required. latitude and longitude (degrees) go together. parkingAddress with parkingLatitude and parkingLongitude (together); empty parkingAddress removes it. isHome=true replaces the home. Omitted fields kept. Refusal changes nothing, answers {error, field}. Returns {success, place}.

save_routine.name: save_routine
save_routine.description: Creates a routine (without id; title, anchor, recurrence required) or changes one (with id; given fields only). title: 255 characters max. anchor: wake, afterBreakfast, afterLunch, afterDinner, or time (needs anchorTime HH:MM, only this anchor). recurrence: {kind: daily}, {kind: weekdays}, {kind: weekly, weekday: 1 Monday to 7 Sunday} or {kind: monthly, monthDay: 1 to 31}. active=false pauses; remind=true asks a reminder. Refused call changes nothing, answers {error}. Returns {success, routine}.

schedule_proaction.name: schedule_proaction
schedule_proaction.description: Schedules ONE run of Maggie: at scheduled_at she receives prompt as instruction. Filed as a five-minute event of the internal Maggie agenda (not synced with Google). Single occurrence; no RRULE. scheduled_at: ISO 8601 with time, e.g. 2037-01-15T08:30:00+01:00, Europe/Paris without offset, in the future. prompt: self-contained. summary: optional agenda label. kind: reminder (default — the owner asked to be told at that time; always interrupts) or check (verifies or watches; speaks only when useful, triaged). Returns the proaction (proaction.scheduledAt).

search.name: search
search.description: Full-text search across the user's own data in Maggie (events, tasks, recipes, products, grocery lists, notifications), any date. Returns matches with highlights. `types` narrows the search (e.g. events); bank transactions are searched only with types=transactions. Event results carry data.startWeekday and endWeekday (timed event), or startWeekday and lastDayWeekday (whole-day event, whose endDate is EXCLUDED; lastDay is its last day). It does not search the Internet.

search_ciqual_foods.name: search_ciqual_foods
search_ciqual_foods.description: Search the Ciqual (ANSES) food database by name. Returns code and kcal, protein, carbs, fat per 100 g.

search_ingredients.name: search_ingredients
search_ingredients.description: Search the user's ingredients by name. Returns id, name and category.

search_products.name: search_products
search_products.description: Searches products (food and non-food) by name; returns id, name, category and type.

search_recipes.name: search_recipes
search_recipes.description: Search recipes by query (name) or tag; one of the two is required.

set_day_plan.name: set_day_plan
set_day_plan.description: Sets the user's day. taskIds is the whole ordered list of the day's tasks, 5 at most: it replaces the slots, so keeping a task means listing it, and a task listed in place of another sends the other back to the reserve. A task appears once. date is YYYY-MM-DD, today when left out; a future day is allowed. confirm=false writes a proposal (confirmedAt stays null). Returns the day as get_day_plan does.

set_trip.name: set_trip
set_trip.description: Set the trip to an event: recomputed now, replaces the trip for that leg and occurrence. date (YYYY-MM-DD, Paris): the occurrence's day; required for a repeating event, else optional and must match. mode: drive, transit, walk, bicycle. origin: position (phone position), place:<id> or event:<id>. arriveAt: ISO 8601 Paris time, whole-day event only, refused otherwise. decidedBy: user (origin kept) or maggie (default). leg: outbound (default) or return (event place to home: no origin/arriveAt; departAt ISO 8601 Paris time is never moved; alert stops 30 min after). Returns {success, trip: {id, eventId, event: {summary, startAt, location}, leg, occurrenceStartAt, mode, arriveAt?, origin: {kind, id, label, latitude, longitude}, originDecidedBy, steps: [{kind, minutes, label?}], durationMinutes, departAt, navigationUrl, computedAt, carLatitude?, carLongitude?}}, Refused: nothing changes, {error, field}; Google down: {error}.

suggest_recurring_operations.name: suggest_recurring_operations
suggest_recurring_operations.description: Detects recurring operations in the bank history (same payee, steady amount, each week to year) and creates accepted ones. Action list writes nothing; minOccurrences (default 3, min 2). Each suggestion: label, counterpartyKey or labelPattern, accountId, period, anchorOn, dayRule, referenceAmountCents (signed cents, negative = expense), occurrences, categoryId. Action accept takes suggestions: list entries sent back unchanged; entries without a category, with a foreign category or account, or whose payee already has a series are ignored. Returns created, attached, proposed; error if none usable.

update_event.name: update_event

reminders.description: minutes before the start, e.g. [60] for "une heure avant"

update_event.description: Update an event by id (master id for a series); only given fields change. Schedule, given whole, never a duration: start_date (YYYY-MM-DD) + start_time (HH:MM) + end_date + end_time, or all_day true + start_date + end_date; end_date is EXCLUDED. An incomplete schedule or an end not after the start changes nothing and returns an error with currentSchedule. clear: fields to empty (description, location, rrule, reminders). agenda_id: name or id; unknown or ambiguous: error listing the agendas. status: tentative or confirmed. reminders: minutes before start; replaces the set. Returns the saved event in its own time zone: allDay; startAt, endAt (timed); startDate, endDate, lastDay (whole-day); status; weekday, startWeekday, endWeekday, lastDayWeekday for each local date.

update_health_day.name: update_health_day
update_health_day.description: Writes a day of the health journal: date (YYYY-MM-DD) and at least one of mood (1-10, 10 best), fatigue (1-10, 10 most tired), note (max 2000 characters; blank removes it). Only arguments given change; a missing day is created, marked as written by Maggie. Returns {success, day} or {error, field, current}.

update_health_profile.name: update_health_profile
update_health_profile.description: Changes the health profile: given arguments only, at least one. sex (male, female), birthYear, heightCm (100-250), weightKg (max 500, also recorded as a weighing), activityLevel (sedentary, light, moderate, active, very_active), mode (computed, entered), enteredNeedKcal (1000-5000), stepGoal (500-50000), suggestionWindowStart, suggestionWindowEnd (HH:MM, end after start), sessionMinutes (15, 20, 30), stepSource (health_connect, none), fastingProtocol (14:10, 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, none), fastingWindowStart (HH:MM). Returns {success, profile}, or {error, field}.

update_recipe.name: update_recipe
update_recipe.description: Update a recipe; only given fields change. ingredients, steps and utensils replace the whole list, formatted as in create_recipe; [] empties steps and utensils. tags: comma-separated, empty string empties. clear: [notes] empties the notes. Unknown recipeId is an error.

update_stock.name: update_stock
update_stock.description: Sets what is left of a product at home: state in_stock, low or out; product is an id or a name. An autoRestock product with a restockQuantity is added to the list. Returns what was added or why not, and the next 7 days' meals using it.

update_task.name: update_task
update_task.description: Updates a task; only given fields change. done=true completes, false reopens. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. parentId makes it a subtask (one level), position orders siblings. estimatedMinutes 1-1440; firstStep. dueDate: deadline; scheduledDate: planned day. scheduledMoment: morning/afternoon/evening, or time with scheduledTime HH:MM; reminders (time only): minutes before; another moment drops them. timed=true: timer. rrule: new rule from the current day; a moved day moves this occurrence only. clear: fields to empty (description, dueDate, parent, estimatedMinutes, firstStep, scheduledDate, scheduledMoment, rrule).
